name: reference-sphere-floor-stronger
prompt: Edit ONLY the cast shadow in this gray reference sphere study. Keep sphere, camera, position, size and upper-left illumination exactly. Make its shadow substantially STRONGER: dense dark neutral-black near-contact core and confident dark elliptical body shadow, sharper nearer sphere and increasingly softer/lighter at far down-right edge. Remove pale gray/lavender halo that looks like illuminated fog around shadow; this is opaque sphere with NO light emission. Shadow must darken an underlying purple floor through variable-alpha black, not paint a gray oval. Keep horizontal floor footprint and complete soft transparent edges, no floor plane or rectangle. True transparent PNG1254 square. This is a low-hover reference; distance and extra blur will later be applied programmatically.
